title: Self-organized formation of topologically correct feature maps
summary: Teuvo Kohonen published 'Self-organized formation of topologically correct feature maps' in Biological Cybernetics in January 1982. The paper studied and simulated a self-organizing process in which signal representations become arranged into topologically ordered output responses.
significance: A documented early self-organizing neural-network milestone centered on topology-preserving feature maps.
